title: Elodie and the Ledger
author: Felix Zhou
blurb: Hazel Brightwater, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
